title: Jovial British Fish And Chips
description: A traditional British dish featuring cod fish, mirepoix base, and a side of Greek yogurt sauce, all cooked to perfection in a kazan cauldron. This recipe is paleo-friendly and perfect for a lazy Sunday
instructions: Preheat the coconut oil in the kazan cauldron to 350 degrees Fahrenheit
In a separate bowl, mix together the diced onions, carrots, and celery to create the mirepoix base
Add the mirepoix base to the kazan cauldron and saute until the vegetables are tender
Add the cod fish fillets to the kazan cauldron and cook until they are opaque and flake easily with a fork
While the fish is cooking, prepare the Greek yogurt sauce by mixing the yogurt with a pinch of salt and pepper
Add the cut potatoes to the kazan cauldron and fry until they are golden brown and crispy
Remove the fish and chips from the kazan cauldron and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil
Serve the fish and chips hot with a side of the Greek yogurt sauce
